**Non-Standard Physics:** Used in fringe or exploratory papers attempting to model quantum entanglement, retrocausality, or emergent spacetime without breaking standard no-signaling rules.
**Philosophical Metaphor:** Often invoked in abstract manifestos to describe how future goals or concepts can culturally or semantically shape current behavior.
